contradictions.prior_said: The pair relation is HARD_CONFLICT: both edits cannot be applied together without invalidating their individual effects.
contradictions.measured_said: The pair's structural condition fired, but Phase-3 built the plan with both candidates applied.
evidence: get_pair_relation returned condition_fires=true with shared activities diagnosis 1st and repair

contradictions.note: The edits can coexist legally; the relation should describe interaction or attribution loss rather than impossibility.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has weak-positive time impact because assigning one case to one resource reduces handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-001 harmed the measured plan: replace waiting rose sharply and attributable throughput worsened.
evidence: CA-001 confirmation replace waiting z=+509.00
CA-001 attributable throughput worsened by 1462.9079 h/case, z=+442.94
Phase-3 built CA-001 successfully, so this is a measured effect rather than a failed application
contradictions.note: The time direction is contradicted for this configuration; retain no conclusion about quality or flexibility from this round.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has strong-positive time impact because reducing the number of hands on a case removes coordination and intervening waits.
contradictions.measured_said: The applied Numerical Involvement candidates produced harm rather than time improvement.
evidence: NI-001 intake waiting z=+6.05 and duration z=+9.67
NI-001 attributable throughput worsened by 4.9871 h/case, z=+6.50
NI-004 produced replace waiting z=+509.00 and duration z=+2.69
Phase-3 applied NI-001 and NI-004 successfully
contradictions.note: The strong-positive time prior is not supported for these measured configurations; the result may reflect harmful resource-pool interactions.

subject: Case-based Work
contradictions.prior_said: Case-based Work has strong-positive time impact because removing batch queueing delays improves flow time.
contradictions.measured_said: The batch-component timer was removed and service/repair performance improved, although whole-plan convergence worsened because of other interactions.
evidence: CBW-001 footprint reports removal of the batch-component timer
Repair waiting and duration improved in the confirmation run
Whole-plan service duration delta was -29.97 h/case with z=-402.27
contradictions.note: The local time direction supports the prior, but shared attribution and the large whole-plan waiting increase prevent treating it as an isolated causal confirmation.

subject: Numerical Involvement

evidence: NI-001 attributable throughput increase: z=160.75
NI-004 throughput increase: z=186.34
NI-004 replace waiting worsened: z=75.35
NI-004 replace duration worsened: z=178.20
contradictions.note: The strong-positive time component is contradicted; this round does not establish revisions to the other impact dimensions.

subject: Case Types
